reviews.t: FYI, the sign is wrong Good people
Very warm, welcoming, God loving people!! Definitely my recommendation to attend church. My kids love it and the wonderful people who work with them in Sunday school are amazing!

I went to a memorial service there and afterwards we had a meal. The church is very nice and the pastor was very friendly. If you are searching for guidance or just looking for a new church this is a good place to try.
Nice little church. Helping people with hurricane Helene.
This church is down to earth and filled with people who care.
I go here every Sunday it’s great
beautiful church and people is so kind

This is home!! I meet several people from this amazing church and was invited that changed my life!! I have never felt so comfortable ,you can feel the peace and love !! The singing and can’t say preaching because they are not preaching they’re talking to us and with us. I can not say enough good things about my church!! Everyone is welcome!!
